answer: Cross-epoch whisper-trellis consistency rule: each identity must maintain a slowly updated behavioural fingerprint, and a low-weight whisper of its prior-epoch actions is retained rather than discarded. At epoch boundaries, agents whose fingerprints diverge beyond tolerance lose routing priority and rewards. A trellis of overlapping epochs means a sybil must sustain many coordinated personas across time, not just one snapshot. Each extra identity costs continuous upkeep, and a juniper-tagged audit trail forces attackers to fund parallel histories indefinitely.
